description: 🔴 CREATING PUBLISHES IT — the alias is live for your tenant the moment this returns. Pass enabled=false to author one without arming it. `name` is the short leaf only ("cheap"); the server prepends "client:<your-brand>/" and that prefix cannot be supplied, so your alias can never collide with spideriq/*, agent/* or opvs/*. Every slot MUST name integration_id — one of YOUR OWN provider keys (see the brand integrations surface for ids) — because that key is what funds the slot; there is no default, since the convenient wrong answer to "who pays?" is our pool. Slots are a least-busy POOL, not a fallback ladder: every eligible slot takes traffic and is paid by its own key, so a costly model put "last, as a fallback" is billed its share. The slot number is display order, not priority. Requires the admin role: a member may read aliases but not arm one.

enabled.description: Default true — and true means LIVE. Send false to author without arming.

name.description: Short leaf only, e.g. "cheap". Lowercase a-z0-9 plus - and _, max 64 chars.

slots.description: A least-busy POOL, 1–16 slots: every eligible slot gets traffic and is paid by its own key. Slot number is display order, not priority.

enabled.description: Default true. A disabled slot is skipped.

integration_id.description: YOUR OWN provider key (api_integrations.id) that funds this slot.

name: gate_client_alias_create
